notes: ACCESS: Akamai Bot Manager interstitial solved exactly as in the prior Home-Decor pass - copied pipeline/final_list_batch_sn21-30/inditex_interstitial_solver.py into the scratchpad unchanged (zh_solver.py), curl_cffi impersonate=chrome, POST /_sec/verify?provider=interstitial with the page bm-verify token and the solved pow value. No proxy used. AE English locale, store 85009931, catalog 50333562. TREE: full category tree from /itxrest/2/catalog/store/85009931/50333562/category?languageId=-1&appId=1 (1.1 MB). Zara Home AE has ONE furniture department, node 1020564154 FURNITURE (/ae/furniture-n4104), and it is FLAT - none of its children has subcategories, so every child is a leaf and there are no grouping rows to emit. Each child's attachments say whether it is in the mega-menu; HIDE_CATEGORY_MENU marks hidden nodes. QTY METHOD: Zara Home publishes no 'N items' / 'Showing 1-N of M' header anywhere on the site, and numberOfProducts is null for every node in the category tree, so qty is the exact size of the category's own server-rendered grid - the unique ccIds returned by /itxrest/3/catalog/store/85009931/50333562/category/<id>/product. This was validated against the rendered PLP HTML four times: furniture-n4104 HTML = 220 unique ccIds = API 220; kids-furniture-n1122 HTML = 32 = API 32; furniture-couches-armchairs-n4113 HTML = 40 = API 40; bedroom-furniture-all-n4130 HTML = 25 = API 25. On a control PLP the union of the colour-filter productIds (54) equalled the grid ccIds (54) exactly, confirming the grid payload is the node's whole catalogue and not a first page. All 19 counts were read twice - all identical, no drift. Counts vary per node (2 to 40), none equals the department total (220) and none is a round display cap. Every URL was fetched and its <title> checked against the node name (e.g. furniture-cabinets-n4899 -> 'Sideboards and Cabinets', bedroom-furniture-all-n4130 -> 'Bedroom furniture'); all 21 candidate URLs returned 200/206, none silently served the parent listing. CROSS-CHECK: the 16 type-level leaves union to 172 distinct products, 161 of which sit inside the 220-product SEE ALL page; the 59 SEE ALL items they do not cover are the kids furniture (31) and the bedroom-only types (bed frames, headboards, chests of drawers, dressing tables), which is exactly why the hidden Bedroom Furniture node is kept. EXCLUDED per brief section 3: SEE ALL (furniture-n4104), BESTSELLERS, and the VINCENT VAN DUYSEN designer collection (vincent-van-duysen-furniture-n3879, 31 items, 26 of them already inside the type leaves). Two hidden room-aggregate nodes were dropped as pure duplicates: MUEBLES COMEDOR / Dining room furniture (dining-furniture-all-n4740, 10 items, grid sections 'Chairs furniture | Diningtables furniture', 8 of 10 already inside Chairs + Dining Tables, both recorded) and KITCHEN FURNITURE (kitchen-furniture-n1409, 17 items - stools, bar stools and storage units - all 17 already inside Stools + Storage Furniture). The KIDS AND BABY department's own FURNITURE entry (node 1020695656) points at the same kids-furniture-n1122 URL, which renders node 1020576160's 32-item grid, so it is recorded once; the BEDDING department's DRESSING ROOM > Furniture entry likewise just points at furniture-n4104. OUT OF SCOPE, left behind: mirrors, lamps and lighting, rugs, cushions, throws, curtains, bed linen, duvets, pillows, mattress protectors, towels, bath mats, bathroom accessories and fixtures, tableware, glassware, cutlery, cookware, table linen, vases, candles, candle holders, photo frames, jewellery boxes, baskets and kids storage, door knobs, clothing and footwear. Zara Home AE has no outdoor / garden / patio department - a grep of the whole tree for outdoor, garden, terrace, patio and exterior returns a single hit, a music playlist page - and no wardrobes or armoires category.
